newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gilles Pelisson to head Euro Disney.
newsitem.headline: Gilles Pelisson to head Euro Disney.

text.p: Euro Disney said president and chief operating officer Gilles Pelisson had been appointed by the board to succeed chairman Philippe Bourguignon, who is leaving to head Club Mediterrannee.

"Gilles has demonstrated superb international management capabilities both at Euro Disney and in his previous positions. We are fortunate to have a manager of his calibre within the company to assure a smooth transition," Euro Disney supervisory board chairman Antoine Jeancourt-Galignani said in a statement.

Pelisson, 40, a graduate of Harvard Business School, came to Euro Disney in 1995 from hotel company Accor, where he had held several international positions and was most recently co-director of the Novotel Hotels chain.
As Euro Disney chief operating officer, Pelisson was in charge of day-to-day management of the theme park and hotels at the Disneyland Paris theme park.
Bourguignon joined Euro Disney in the planning stages in 1988. "Philippe has done a magnificent job," Jeancourt-Galignani said.
Euro Disney is 39 percent owned by The Walt Disney Co .
